summary: Iteration 11 e2e validation of 'Voice Everywhere' on the WEB app (Chat Listen + Money Insights Listen) plus regression. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py -> 8/8 PASSED (44s). POST /api/tts requires auth (401/403 unauth), 400 on blank/markdown-only text, 200 with {url:/api/tts/<key>.mp3} for chat-reply-sized text, content-hash cached (same text -> same url), markdown/links stripped OK; GET of the url returns 200 audio/mpeg >1KB, unknown key -> 404. Money Insights flow: uploaded TEST_it11_statement.csv -> POST /api/insights/statement 200 with result{summary,recurring,advice,...}, no _id leakage, and the exact Listen payload the UI builds synthesizes to a playable mp3 (>5KB). Chat regression: POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/message streams a non-empty reply, persisted assistant message re-synthesizes via /api/tts 200 audio/mpeg, no _id in message rows. GET /api/insights history clean of _id. FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920x1080, demo@example.com/demo123): (1) CHAT LISTEN — new chat, sent 'Give me one quick budgeting tip', reply streamed, [data-testid=listen-message] appeared after streaming; click -> POST /api/tts 200 + GET /api/tts/<key>.mp3 200; window.Audio instrumentation confirmed play() called, 'playing' event fired, no media error, zero app JS/page errors. (2) INSIGHTS LISTEN — /insights, stmt.csv selected, Analyze -> [data-testid=insights-result] with stats (Total spend USD 2,300, Income USD 5,000), click [data-testid=listen-insights] -> POST /api/tts 200 and <audio data-testid=insights-audio> rendered with absolute src https://<host>/api/tts/<key>.mp3, autoplaying (paused=false, readyState=4, duration 31.8s, currentTime 7.8s, error=null). (3) REGRESSION — document-grounded chat 'List the expenses in my bank statement' -> [data-testid=message-sources] chip 'stmt.csv'; nav sweep /insights /investments /loans /vault /legacy /insurance /profile /forms /bundle /dashboard all render without crash; Insurance Policy Guide (Health, no document) analyzed and [data-testid=listen-policy] -> policy-audio playing (t=5.9s, readyState 4, no error). CLEANUP: 2 test conversations + 4 messages, 2 test insight rows, 1 policy_analyses row deleted; uploaded TEST_it11_statement.csv deleted via API (soft delete is_deleted=true). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Still unauthenticated (carried over from iteration 10): anyone with the 24-char key can stream audio that narrates the user's financial/policy summary. Consider signing the key per-session or requiring the session cookie.
In-process dict cache means audio is lost on backend reload/restart and is not shared across workers -> GET can 404 shortly after a successful POST (client shows no retry/regenerate path).

ui_bugs.issue: No loading/disabled state while TTS generates (Insights uses 'Preparing…'); repeated clicks can create multiple overlapping Audio() objects with no way to stop playback (no pause/stop control since there is no <audio> element).

issues: Native browser <audio controls> widget (white/light) sits inside the dark theme and looks visually out of place vs the rest of the UI — same as the Insurance page player.

action_items: Optional: add busy/disabled state to the chat Listen button and prevent overlapping playback.
Optional hardening: protect GET /api/tts/{key}.mp3 or scope keys per user session; handle 404 'Audio expired' by regenerating client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_voice.py _CACHE is a module-level in-memory dict — not durable across restarts and not multi-worker safe; a POST-then-GET race after reload yields a 404 with no client fallback.
GET /api/tts/{key}.mp3 has no auth dependency while the synthesized content is user-private.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (chat listen, insights listen, doc-grounded chat, nav sweep, policy guide listen)

seed_data_creation: TEST_it11_statement.csv (uploaded then deleted), 2 test chat conversations (deleted), 2 insight rows + 1 policy_analyses row (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Everywhere on web is verified end-to-end. Chat Listen has no <audio> element — instrument window.Audio in an init script to assert playback. Insights Listen renders <audio data-testid=insights-audio> and autoplays in headless Chrome. /api/tts cache is in-memory: after a backend reload old mp3 URLs 404. Note: preview-tool instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option> in Insights, producing a harmless React hydration console warning (not app code). Mobile /app/mobile GuideScreen remains untestable here.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced; only hardening/UX observations.
